question: ______ is known as the ‘Grand Old Lady’ of the Independence Movement.
solution:
The correct answer is "__ Aruna Asaf Ali__ ".

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Aruna Asaf Ali** was a political activist who participated in the **Indian Independence movement.**
 
• She is known for hoisting the Indian flag at the Gowalia Tank Maidan in Mumbai during the Quit India Movement.
 
• In 1958, She also became " Delhi's first mayor ".
